text:
Harper (CS): Orion flagged several onboarding blockers in today's success call. Renewal touchpoint in ~5w. Can we prioritize?
Noah (CS): Quick notes from their ops lead: 
- Relevance: after bulk ingest their search returns board meeting notes instead of device SOPs.
- Billing: they want usage split by environment and per-route toggles; current single-key model mixes test/prod.
- Bulk ingest: jobs time out at ~25k rows and retry is manual. They lost a day.
Leila (PM): Thanks. My read: relevance is P0 (blocks day-to-day value), billing split is P1 (commercial ask), ingest reliability P2. We should triage relevance first.
Aiden (ENG): Need a sanitized failing example + request ids and whether they used UI or API ingest. Can CS post one sample we can repro with?
Harper (CS): Sanitized sample below and one request id from today: orion-req-2026-10-12-77
```
{"text":"Sterilizer maintenance checklist v3","model":"redwood-sim-1.1","metadata":{"org":"orion-med"}}
```
They used the API bulk endpoint.
Noah (CS): Customer quote: "Search keeps surfacing unrelated meeting notes  makes the tool unusable for on-shift triage."
triage-bot: Created ticket CS-7042 and linked to ENG-2598.
Leila (PM): Proposed plan: 1) ENG triage (48h) to validate vectorization and model routing. Owner: Aiden. 2) Product draft RFC for env-scoped keys + per-route billing (next sprint). 3) CS to collect two more sanitized examples and customer impact notes for renewal memo.
Aiden (ENG): I'll take the triage. Plan: reproduce with the payload, run NN checks across our vectorstores, verify fallback model mapping, and check similarity threshold. Expect update in 48h.
Harper (CS): I'll tell Orion we'll provide a triage update in 48h and ask permission to run a quick mitigation on a sample dataset.
Noah (CS): I'll add renewal stakeholders to the thread and attach quotes to CS-7042.
Leila (PM): Quick decision: if triage shows routing bug, we fast-track a patch. If it's model selection, propose a config to pin model for CSV/API ingest.
Aiden (ENG): If helpful, interim mitigation is to apply a domain prefix filter during ingestion and tighten similarity cutoffs. Low-risk to prototype.
Harper (CS): Orion is happy to try a prototype. I'll coordinate and schedule a 20-min follow-up once we have the mitigation ready.
triage-bot: Added renewal risk tag to CS-7042.
Leila (PM): Thanks team. Please update CS-7042 with any customer logs and the triage outcome; we'll reflect this in the renewal risk memo.
Aiden (ENG): Starting repro now, will post findings here.
Harper (CS): Closing loop for now. If product deprioritizes per-route billing, say so; otherwise I'll keep it flagged for renewal briefing.
